title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Issue of Free Night Awards
content:
These clauses of the Ashbury Rewards programme terms govern when Free Night Awards are issued and to whom.

**1. Issue source.** Each award type is issued only for its own issue source.

**2. Co-brand card anniversary awards.** An award whose issue source is the co-brand card account anniversary is deposited once per card account anniversary to a member whose linked co-brand card on the anniversary is the co-brand card the award type requires.

**3. Elite night milestone awards.** An award whose issue source is an elite night milestone is deposited once per calendar year, on the day the member's elite night credits for the year first reach the award type's milestone nights.

**4. Promotion awards.** An award whose issue source is a registered promotion is deposited once per completed registered promotion.

**5. Deposit window.** Awards are deposited within the award type's deposit window, counted in calendar days, of the qualifying anniversary, milestone or promotion.

**6. Expiry date (no longer in force).** The former clause under which the expiry date was the award type's validity months after the issue date, on the same day number or on the last day of that month when it had no such day, with a reissued award running its replacement validity from its reissue date instead, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the expiry date of a replacement award.

**7. Active membership.** An award is issued only to a membership whose status is active. The status is the one shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership record in the system, for the membership the award is issued into; what the member says about the account does not replace it.

**8. Once per occasion.** An award is issued at most once for each qualifying occasion. An award of the same type and issue source already deposited in the membership for that occasion, whatever its present status (issued, applied, redeemed, expired or forfeited), is the award of that occasion, and no second award is issued for it.

**9. Extension and value.** Expiry dates are never extended where the award type's terms do not allow extension, and an award has no cash value and may not be sold.

### Applying the clauses (hypothetical members)

| Hypothetical situation | Under the clauses |
|---|---|
| Elite night credits for the year first reach a type's milestone nights; the membership is active | The milestone award of that type is deposited for that calendar year, within the deposit window |
| The same member's credits rise further within the same year past that milestone | No second award of that type for that year |
| A card account anniversary falls on a day when the linked co-brand card is not the card the type requires | The anniversary is not a qualifying occasion for that type |
| The membership is suspended or closed on the day an award would be issued | No award is issued to it |
| An award of the same type and issue source for the same occasion already stands expired in the membership | That award was the occasion's award; none is issued again |

superseded_clauses: The expiry date is validity_months calendar months after the issue date, on the same day number, or on the last day of that month when it has no such day; a reissued award runs reissue_validity_months from its reissue date instead.
